question: Which deities and principles must be installed alongside the earth form in this rite?
premises: The earth form and its lords are to be installed
The world guardians are also included
inference: One should install the earth form, its lords, and also the world guardians.
uncertainties: The exact segmentation and reading of kṣmāmūrtitadī'sānān is uncertain.
plain_english: One should install the earth form and its lords, and also the guardians of the worlds.
